summary_and_theme.summary: A wealthy merchant keeps a beautiful talking parrot in a luxurious golden cage. Before traveling to a distant forest on business, the merchant asks his parrot if it desires any gift. The parrot asks him to deliver greetings to its wild relatives in the forest. When the merchant delivers the message, a wild parrot falls to the ground motionless. Returning home, the merchant sorrowfully recounts this event to his caged bird. Understanding the message, the caged parrot feigns death. Sorrowfully, the merchant opens the cage and places the bird on the window sill. Instantly, the parrot revives, flies to freedom, and thanks his wild friend for teaching him the secret to escape.
summary_and_theme.core_theme: The supreme value of freedom, wisdom, clever communication, and solidarity among living beings.

character_sketches.name: The Caged Parrot
character_sketches.profile: A clever and perceptive bird who longs for liberty and uses intelligence and strategic thinking to win its freedom.

character_sketches.name: The Merchant
character_sketches.profile: A wealthy trader who cares for his pet bird in comfort but fails to understand that no gold cage can replace the open sky.

character_sketches.name: The Wild Parrot
character_sketches.profile: A wise jungle parrot who cleverly communicates a secret plan of escape by acting out a feigned death.

options: It fell motionless to the ground

reading_extracts.extract: The merchant couldn't understand how his beloved pet died so suddenly. He reached into the cage and gently took the still warm body of the bird and placed it on the windowsill. As soon as he stepped back, the bird stirred, stretched its beautiful green wings and flew off into the open sky saying, 'My friend showed me how I could escape and now I can fly in the sky. Goodbye!'

writing_prompts.topic: Write a dialogue between the merchant and the wise parrot right after it lands safely on a tree outside.
writing_prompts.model_answer:
Merchant: (Surprised) 'You tricked me! You were not dead at all!'
Parrot: 'Forgive me, master. I had to pretend to be dead to gain my freedom. A golden cage is still a prison.'
Merchant: 'I treated you with great luxury and love!'
Parrot: 'True, but no gold can replace the open sky and my natural family. Goodbye, master!'
Merchant: (Sighing) 'Go in peace. I finally understand that wild birds belong in the sky.'

grammar_exercises.type: Present Perfect Tense and Collective Nouns
grammar_exercises.instruction: Fill in the blanks using correct present perfect verb forms or collective nouns:

items.q: The merchant ________ (deliver) the message to the forest birds.
A ________ of parrots settled on the banyan tree.
items.explanation: Flock is the collective noun for birds.

items.q: An ________ of ants marched near the roots.
items.explanation: Army is a collective noun for ants.

short_answer.question: How did the wild forest parrot secretly convey a message of escape to the caged parrot?
short_answer.answer: The wild parrot conveyed the secret message by dropping motionless to the ground upon hearing about the caged bird, demonstrating that feigning death was the key to being released from captivity.

short_answer.question: What is the moral lesson taught by 'The Wise Parrot'?
short_answer.answer: The story teaches that freedom is invaluable and cannot be substituted by wealth or luxury. It also shows that intelligence and unity can overcome difficult captivity.

long_answer.question: Detail the master plan executed by the caged parrot to gain its freedom from the merchant's golden cage.
long_answer.answer: The caged parrot laid the foundation of its escape by asking the merchant to deliver greetings to its wild friends in the forest. When a wild parrot dropped motionless after hearing the news, the merchant mistakenly believed it died of heartbreak. Upon returning, the merchant recounted this event to his pet. The clever caged parrot immediately grasped the secret code and feigned death in its cage. Heartbroken, the merchant picked up the motionless bird and laid it on the windowsill. The moment the merchant stepped back, the parrot revived, stretched its wings, and flew into the open sky, outsmarting its captor through sheer intellect.
rubric: 2 Marks: Explanation of the forest incident and the coded signal
2 Marks: Description of the parrot feigning death and final escape
1 Mark: Grammar, thematic coherence, and vocabulary
